responsibility: Implements analysis and propagation that classifies functions as const, pure, nothrow, malloc-like, or looping variants of pure/const. It scans bodies and callgraph effects, maintains per-function lattice state, suggests user attributes, updates cgraph flags and declarations, and provides both IPA and local GIMPLE passes for pure/const, noreturn, and nothrow discovery. This file is GCC’s side-effect classification engine for functions after inlining decisions are known.
